text:
eli: Kicking off a q6b-int4 smoke for long summarization today. Noticed a small regression on our fragile_long_summ slice during local tests. Need a tight 800-sample focused pull + micro-golden to validate.
kate: I can take curation lead. What split are we targeting?
eli: Plan: 70% fragile_long_summ, 20% attrition_dialog, 10% code-doc-mismatch. Micro-golden: 120 full-golden, rest fast-review.
maya: Agree on micro-golden. Propose dedupe step (fuzzyhash 0.9) then paraphrase-cluster prune to avoid duplicate anchors in golden.
label-bot: queuing sample job id lb-178001 10: SELECT id, prompt, meta FROM samplebank WHERE slice IN ('fragile_long_summ','attrition_dialog','code_doc_mismatch') ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 800; ETA ~8m.
ops-bot: Note: labeler pool has ~260 pending tasks. Expect +2h if we push full-golden for all. Micro-golden will keep SLA ~45m.
kate: Good to know. We'll reserve the 120 golden slots and mark remainder as expedited 1.5x pay queue.
eli: Also attach q6b-int4 outputs + baseline q8b-int3 and q6b-fp16. Want token-diff logs and a small comparator CSV with columns: id, rougeL_delta, chrF_delta, token_inserts, token_deletes, primary_regress_flag.
devx-cog: I'll add comparator to pipeline. Pseudocode: ```python
for row in sample:
  out_a = fetch('q6b-int4', id)
  out_b = fetch('q8b-int3', id)
  metrics = compute(rougeL, chrF, token_diff)
  emit_csv(id, metrics)
``` Artifact will be at s3://redwood-curation/curation/178001/lb-178001/comparator.csv when done.
maya: For labeling instructions: emphasize long-answer faithfulness and instruction following; include a short rubric and 3 exemplars per slice in the label task.
kate: Also flag code examples where the model drops docstrings or incorrectly truncates. That's been a failure mode.
label-bot: sample job completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-curation/curation/178001/lb-178001/ (includes sampled.csv, dedupe_log.txt). 120 items routed to golden, 680 to expedited-review queue.
eli: Perfect. After comparator runs, let's reconvene in 45m to review top-20 regressions and decide go/no-go. If rougeL_delta < -0.05 avg across fragile_long_summ we'll do rollback.
ops-bot: Reminder: add metric tag "quant_smoke_regcheck" to all examples so console dashboards pick them up.
devx-cog: Comparator finished and uploaded: s3://redwood-curation/curation/178001/lb-178001/comparator.csv (summary: fragile_long_summ avg rougeL_delta = -0.032, top regressions id: 4312, 1178, 5209).
kate: Noted. Slight regression but under our rollback threshold; still want manual review of top regressions.
maya: I'll start reviewing the 120 golden now and annotate structural issues.
eli: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Will post triage notes after the review meeting. :sparkles:
